name: technologist-academy-node-service-template
description: A template repository for node services developed in the Technologist Academy

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node22 --packages=external --outfile=dist/index.js --sourcemap && node --input-type=module -e "import { cpSync } from 'node:fs'; cpSync('src/views', 'dist/views', { recursive: true });"
